title: Keyboard manager from alt +A to ctrl left + A isn't working

judgment.rationale: The report describes a concrete Alt+A→Left Ctrl+A mapping that previously worked but now leaves Alt unmapped on PowerToys 0.84.1. It includes an exported settings attachment and Windows build, and the live issue is labeled Status-Reproducible. Replay the mapping on a current build before selecting a code change.
evidence: The body specifies PowerToys 0.84.1, Windows 11 23H2 build 22631.4169, and Alt+A expected to invoke Ctrl+A.
The reporter says the configuration worked before and the Alt mapping is not active.
A settings JSON attachment is referenced; its contents were not downloaded or copied.
judgment.recommended_action: Recreate the Alt+A→Ctrl+A mapping on a current build and compare the source modifier state with the existing mapping configuration.

fix_assessment.rationale: The reproducible label and historical configuration establish a test case, but current behavior and the responsible remap stage have not been revalidated.

issue_context.summary: An Alt+A→Left Ctrl+A mapping reportedly stopped working after previously functioning, with the reporter observing that Alt is not mapped.
known_information: Reported on PowerToys 0.84.1, auto-update, running as administrator.
The author attached a settings export; it was not downloaded or inspected.
The issue has no comments or assignees and carries Status-Reproducible.
inferences: The issue may be a mapping-load or source-modifier recognition regression, but the settings attachment and current behavior have not been independently checked.
issue_context.analysis: The exact expected mapping and environment are adequate for controlled replay. Do not request another settings dump unless a current reproduction shows the existing configuration is insufficient.
initial_investigation: Read the full live body and checked current labels, comments, assignees, and linked work.
Did not download the attached settings file or inspect unrelated user configuration.

actions.label: Replay Alt+A to Ctrl+A on current build

reproduce.title: Verify Alt+A to Left Ctrl+A mapping
prerequisites: Current upstream main or current build
Windows 11 23H2 or a current Windows 11 build
steps: Create an Alt+A→Left Ctrl+A shortcut remap and save it.
In a standard text editor, invoke Alt+A and verify the expected select-all action.
Check the mapping after restarting PowerToys and after signing in again.
If it fails, compare the saved source modifier and active Keyboard Manager mapping state without exporting unrelated settings.
reproduce.expected_result: Alt+A invokes Ctrl+A consistently after saving and after PowerToys restart/sign-in.
